title: Bi-HYCO: Bi-Objective Cooperative Learning for PDE Parameter Identification under Fragmented Observations
abstract: arXiv:2609.06511v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physical and synthetic models may describe complementary aspects of the same PDE-governed system while receiving different, possibly fragmented, observations. We propose Bi-Objective HYCO (Bi-HYCO), a cooperative framework that retains both representations and their local observational objectives while coupling their predicted states at unlabeled interaction points. These points contain no measurements and do not augment the data; they provide a communication mechanism in the common state space. The two criteria form a vector-valued objective, and weighted scalarizations provide computational realizations. For the deterministic shared-observation algorithm with fixed interaction points, we prove sufficient decrease and finite length of the whole alternating sequence, which converges to a mixed critical point under the stated Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz-type assumptions. translated_title: Bi-HYCO：碎片化观测下用于偏微分方程参数识别的双目标协同学习
translated_abstract: 物理模型与合成模型可能从互补角度描述同一偏微分方程（PDE）支配的系统，同时接收不同的、可能是碎片化的观测数据。我们提出双目标HYCO（Bi-HYCO），这是一个协同学习框架，在保留两种模型表示及其各自局部观测目标的同时，通过无标签的交互点耦合二者的预测状态。这些交互点不包含任何测量数据，也不扩充数据集；它们在共同状态空间中充当通信机制。两个目标准则构成向量值目标函数，加权标量化方法为其提供了计算实现。针对具有固定交互点的确定性共享观测算法，我们证明了整个交替序列的充分下降性和有限长度，并在给定的Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz型假设下证明其收敛于混合临界点。通过椭圆传输问题和二维Navier-Stokes实验对该方法进行了评估（原摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出双目标协同学习框架Bi-HYCO，通过无标签交互点耦合物理模型与合成模型的预测状态，在碎片化观测条件下实现偏微分方程参数识别，并提供了严格的收敛性理论证明。
en_tdlr: Bi-HYCO is proposed as a bi-objective cooperative learning framework that couples physical and synthetic models at unlabeled interaction points for PDE parameter identification under fragmented observations, with rigorous convergence guarantees.
